items.reason: Hiltonol is described as 'used as an adjuvant to the vaccine, meaning it is used with the vaccine to stimulate or enhance the activation of your immune system'; it has no own arm or outcome, so under R4 it is part of the excluded vaccine therapy and the trial has no candidate.
Poly-ICLC is a vaccine adjuvant (R4 lists poly-ICLC explicitly); the booster-phase home injections are still part of the vaccine regimen and no outcome tests it in its own right.
As for coder A's flag: the only non-vaccine agent is the poly-ICLC adjuvant, which R4 treats as part of the excluded vaccine.
Same as coder A: 'used as an adjuvant to the vaccine'; no own arm or outcome.

The only biomarker endpoints are vaccine-specific T-cell responses ('Change in Mean Fold Increase in EphA2- or Survivin- Specific T Cells'), which measure the excluded vaccine, not a candidate; with no candidate left after R4, there is no candidate target-engagement measure.

note: Trial excluded at S6 under R4. any_molecular_selection=true from the MGMT-unmethylated entry requirement (IDH-wildtype defines GBM only). target_engagement 'no' is moot once excluded; 'unclear' is the alternative if XL reads the T-cell endpoints as candidate-linked.
